implementation.summary: D25 closes the bounded local P7 contract/check/result/report journey over the real SQLite/HTTP composition, exposes versioned quality contracts and durable evidence through the public CLI, and makes Quality Studio inherit the active workspace context.

commands.cleanup_and_regenerate: candidate-boundary cleanup was run after test caches and browser dependencies; the same SHA was regenerated with identical archive and manifest hashes; final verify passed
commands.candidate_focused: exact candidate sandbox pytest local-composed quality/graph journey, quality HTTP/runtime/store tests, PyRonin catalog/ontology/graph tests and CLI integration tests
commands.candidate_web: exact candidate sandbox npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts followed by Playwright Quality Studio; SKIP because Chromium headless launch timed out at 180000 ms on two attempts; checkout equivalent passed 2/2
commands.candidate_static: exact candidate sandbox ruff format --check, ruff check, mypy, architecture, negative gates, route consistency, dependency surfaces, OpenAPI, Studio surface, web audit, web budget, daily progress and capability status
commands.scans: Gitleaks directory scan and pip-audit -r requirements-test.lock over the final clean exact candidate; Trivy skipped because no local binary was available

qualification_matrix.candidate_focused_suite: 2 local-composed journeys passed (quality and prior graph/ontology), 47 quality HTTP/runtime/store tests passed, and 7 PyRonin/CLI catalog-quality-graph tests passed; no failures or skips in these focused suites

qualification_matrix.checkout_web: 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 1.3 minutes against the checkout static server
qualification_matrix.candidate_static: ruff format 1129 files, Ruff, mypy 451 source files, architecture, negative gates, route consistency 200 operations, dependency surfaces, OpenAPI digest 315cdee5a324a972975b682809797142b5c1639286f072cb8972c2db09663708, Studio 129/242, web audit 72 files/184 route invocations and web budget 2169891 bytes passed
qualification_matrix.ledger_checks: ronin_daily_progress --check --report passed in the exact archive at the archived D24 ledger state (24/39, NO-GO); generate_public_v1_status --check is SKIP in the archive because it requires Git metadata; checkout checks are recorded after the D25 evidence commit
qualification_matrix.candidate_reproducibility_after_cleanup: pass; cleanup/regeneration produced the same archive and manifest hashes and final verify passed
qualification_matrix.checkout_integrity_checks: host checkout git diff --check and main/origin identity are checked separately; the candidate sandbox intentionally has no .git metadata
qualification_matrix.result: D25 pass for bounded local workspace-scoped quality contract/check/result/report evidence through real HTTP, PyRonin and CLI; P7 remains in_progress and is not qualified

security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition stores the contract and runs in workspace-1; an unknown workspace receives HTTP/SDK 403 and malformed row input receives HTTP/SDK 400 before evidence is recorded.
security_and_recovery.contract_and_gate: A canonical row-count contract is PUT and read back, its digest is pinned for execution, a populated row set returns gate_passed true, and an empty row set returns gate_passed false without enforce_blocking; no failed threshold is reported as PASS.
security_and_recovery.persistence_and_recovery: The contract, passed/failed history and latest failed state are read through SDK and CLI, then recovered from the same SQLite database after composition restart.
security_and_recovery.operator_surface: CLI exposes contract get/put, run, history and state over the same authenticated control-plane routes; Quality Studio initializes from the active workspace query/context instead of always defaulting to default.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the real local SQLite composition was exercised. PostgreSQL quality storage, optional SQL/Python custom-rule providers, external alert delivery and provider/operator certification were not run and are not claimed.

scans.gitleaks: 8.30.1; final clean exact-candidate directory scan of 15,654,188 bytes; 0 findings
scans.trivy: SKIP; no local Trivy binary; no substitute scan claimed

open_cells: P7 remains in_progress, not qualified: provider-backed quality storage, optional SQL/Python rule execution, complete catalog/lineage quality-state integration, broader alert/product journeys and provider/consumer certification remain open.

Candidate browser evidence is SKIP because the sandbox Chromium process did not launch within 180000 ms; the checkout UI contract passed separately and is not substituted for candidate provider evidence.
P6, P13 and all other non-P1 families retain their ledger states; P13 remains blocked by the external secret-provider and release evidence boundary.
No release gate is closed; release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
limitations: The exact candidate sandbox has no .git metadata by design; generate_public_v1_status --check therefore remains a candidate SKIP and was not converted into PASS.

Playwright dependencies were installed offline only in the temporary candidate sandbox for the attempted browser run and were removed by cleanup before regeneration; node_modules is not part of the candidate archive.
Static checks and scans were rerun on the final clean regenerated candidate; final verify passed with no generated caches or test artifacts.
No hosted workflow or GitHub Actions evidence was used.
